name: BioRender

original_description: Search BioRender's library of scientific templates, find your files, and generate custom first-draft figures with AI. Results and previews appear right in your conversation, and every item links back to BioRender so you can open and keep editing.

limitations_ja: 生成図の科学的な正確性、利用料金、公開・商用利用の条件は未確認。
